name: EPIC 220667052

text.card: A red giant 4,164 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.77 solar masses and 11.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,866 K at its surface.
